title: Code and data for: Adaptive Coordination of MPPT and Virtual Inertia Control in Grid-Connected PV-BESS Systems with Limit-Cycle Detection
description: Averaged PV-BESS model (Python, with a Julia port), robust Monte Carlo-CVaR / NSGA-II tuning, scenario campaign, describing-function and circle-criterion analysis, robustness tests of revision R1, and the switching-level Simulink testbed, with all raw results and figures. Accompanies the article submitted to Emerging Science Journal.
